risk_description: Digital-first channel may exclude users with low digital access or assistive needs
Model may misclassify high-need cases and obscure accountability
Reminder timing or framing may pressure users without enough transparency
Reduced support may shift hidden labor to users caregivers and frontline staff
Co-design language may overstate participant influence
Personalization may infer sensitive characteristics or obscure data use
Automated triage may affect access without explanation appeal or repair
Simplified language may omit rights exceptions or consequences
